profile.headline: Software Engineer - Intuit Enterprise Suite | Graduate @ Cornell Tech
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary:
At IES, I'm working with the latest tech in AI to bring prosperity to businesses using our products.

With a foundation built at Cornell Tech, I've come to posses a unique blend of skills in computer science, human psychology, and design. This multidisciplinary background equips me to approach technology with a holistic perspective, focusing not only on technical excellence but also on creating user-centric, engaging experiences. 

Excited to continue my journey, collaborating, and contributing to a future where technology serves as a catalyst for positive change and shared prosperity.

positions.title: Forward Deployed Engineer / Software Engineer - Intuit Enterprise Suite
Software Engineer - Quickbooks
positions.description: Skills: React.js · TypeScript · GraphQL · Kotlin · RAG · Artificial Intelligence (AI)

positions.title: Co-Founder
positions.description:
• Co-founded a browser-based 3D learning platform, leading product development as a full-stack engineer. 
• Led user research efforts, conducting 75 stakeholder interviews with students, parents, teachers, administrators and government officials to understand user needs and pain points.  
• Conducted user testing across three schools, incorporating user feedback into the design and functionality of the platform optimising the student learning experience.
positions.insights: Skills: Start-up Leadership · Start-up Ventures · React.js · REST APIs · Amazon Web Services (AWS)

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Streamlined post-acquisition user experience by implementing Intuit's React micro-frontend architecture for key customer-facing pages, enabling smooth integration between Trada's Ruby on Rails platform and Intuit's services
• Actively participated in Agile development practices, collaborating with cross-functional teams to enhance product features and ensure timely delivery on a biweekly basis
positions.insights: Skills: React.js · Agile Methodologies · Ruby on Rails · JavaScript

positions.title: Graduate Teaching Assistant - Start Up Studio
positions.description:
• Contributed to the evaluation process by grading teams in the program
• Partnered with the studio team to plan and organise class sessions.
• Liaised with studio teams to identify and address their requirements.
positions.insights: Skills: Community Outreach · Leadership · Educational Outreach · Communication

positions.title: AR App Developer
positions.description:
• Developed AR Apps using the Unity Game Engine for elementary school students.
• Used the Vuforia AR SDK to incorporate virtual buttons and target-image based actions to make remote learning more engaging.
• Developed Apps on History and Geography, using videos and animations with the school textbook as the target image.
positions.insights: Skills: Unity · Blender · C# · Augmented Reality (AR)

positions.title: Remote Research Fellow
positions.description:
• Worked on Image Processing projects, analyzing the effect of different chemical compounds on Cardiomyocytes.
• Developed a web crawler to mine public data from the Mayo Clinic and NHS website about diseases and their symptoms to create a database for the machine learning model.
• Contributed to a proof-of-concept to enable seamless integration across various healthcare stakeholders using Hyperledger Fabric and IPFS. Paper published in the International Conference on Blockchain : https://link.springer.com/chapter/10.1007/978-3-030-96527-3_2
positions.insights: Skills: Blockchain · Image Processing · Data Mining

positions.title: Research Fellow
positions.description:
• Applied a Bag of Words approach to classify the category of a given news article.
• Performed Sentiment Analysis on Tweets using Python programming, TextBlob library and Twitter API.
• Visually illustrated proximity of words to others and their likelihood of occurring together using python programming and Gephi.

educations.degreeName: Jacobs Technion-Cornell Dual Master of Science Degrees – Connective Media Concentration
educations.fieldOfStudy: Applied Information Science and Information Systems

volunteerExperiences.description: • Served as a Music Teacher and assisted Teach For India fellow's with grading class work in government schools, working with students from impoverished backgrounds.

• Set up libraries in economically weaker schools, helping the teacher in charge with class work.
• Worked to try and inculcate the love for reading among students from marginalized communities in India.
